many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[row[:] for row in grid]
    corners=[(0,0),(0,W-1),(H-1,0),(H-1,W-1)]
    pos=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c]!=bg: pos[grid[r][c]].append((r,c))
    for v,ps in pos.items():
        ps=set(ps)
        # diagonal chains: connectivity along a single diagonal line (maximal contiguous)
        comps=[]; seen=set()
        for p in sorted(ps):
            if p in seen: continue
            # gather cells on same diagonal line(s) connected via adjacency
            stack=[p]; comp={p}
            while stack:
                u=stack.pop()
                for q in ps:
                    if abs(q[0]-u[0])==abs(q[1]-u[1])==1 and q not in comp:
                        stack.append(q); comp.add(q)
            for q in comp: seen.add(q)
            comps.append(comp)
        for comp in comps:
            cs=sorted(comp, key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1]))
            n=len(cs)
            if n<2: continue
            # determine diagonal direction from the chain
            dr=cs[1][0]-cs[0][0]; dc=cs[1][1]-cs[0][1]
            dirs=[(dr,dc),(-dr,-dc)]
            ends=[cs[0],cs[-1]]
            cand=[]
            for e in ends:
                for dd in dirs:
                    pass
            # rule: extend from the end whose nearest corner is farther,
            # in the direction away from that end's nearest corner, along the chain's line
            def ne(c): return min(corners, key=lambda cc:abs(c[0]-cc[0])+abs(c[1]-cc[1]))
            e=ends[max(0,key=lambda x:-sum(abs(e[0]-q)+abs(e[1]-q) for q in corners))]  # placeholder
            # compute per-end direction away from nearest corner
            for k,e in enumerate(ends):
                nc=min(corners,key=lambda cc:abs(e[0]-cc[0])+abs(e[1]-cc[1]))
                dd=((e[0]-nc[0]),(e[1]-nc[1]))
                # dd may not align with chain line; choose chain dir matching sign pattern
                chos=[d for d in [(dr,dc),(-dr,-dc)] if (d[0]>=0)==(dd[0]>=0)][:1]
                cand.append((e,dd if dd in [(dr,dc),(-dr,-dc)] else None, abs(dd)))
            best=max(cand,key=lambda t:(t[2] if t[2] is not None else -1, -t[1][0], -t[1][1]))[0]
            e,bestdd=None,None
            # simpler: pick the end that maximizes (distance to its nearest corner) and use direction away from that corner constrained to chain line
            scores=[]
            for k,e in enumerate(ends):
                nc=min(corners,key=lambda cc:abs(e[0]-cc[0])+abs(e[1]-cc[1]))
                dd=(e[0]-nc[0],e[1]-nc[1])
                # project onto chain line
                if dd==(dr,dc): d2=(dr,dc); sgn=1
                elif dd==(-dr,-dc): d2=(-dr,-dc); sgn=-1
                else: sgn=None
                scores.append((len([p for p in range(H)]) , k, e, d2, sgn, nc))
            # choose end with larger Manhattan distance to its nearest corner
            def dman(p,q): return abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1])
            picked=max([(dman(end,ne(end)),i) for i,end in enumerate(ends)],key=lambda t:t[0])[1]
            e=cand[picked][0]; bdd=cand[picked][2]
            cur=e
            while True:
                pr,pc=cur[0]+bdd[0],cur[1]+bdd[1]
                if not(0<=pr<H and 0<=pc<W) or res[pr][pc]!=bg: break
                res[pr][pc]=v; cur=(pr,pc)
    return [list(r) for r in res]

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def f(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # group by color (each color its own set of cells; within color, 8-connectivity)
    pos=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c]!=bg: pos[grid[r][c]].append((r,c))
    for v,ps in pos.items():
        ps=set(ps)
        seen=set(); groups=[]
        for p in ps:
            if p in seen: continue
            stack=[p]; grp={p}; seen.add(p)
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop()
                for dy in(-1,0,1):
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        q=(a+dy,b+dx)
                        if q in ps and q not in grp:
                            grp.add(q); seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            groups.append(grp)
        for grp in groups:
            cs=sorted(grp)
            if len(cs)<2:
                # singleton: away from nearest other-color cell
                best=None
                for q in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]!=bg and grid[r][c]!=v]:
                    d=(q[0]-cs[0][0])**2+(q[1]-cs[0][1])**2
                    if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,q)
                if best is None: continue
                oth=best[1]
                # dir away from oth
                dr=sign(oth[0]-cs[0][0]); dc=sign(oth[1]-cs[0][1])
                # choose a diagonal closest to (dr,dc)
                cands=[(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]
                dd=max(cands,key=lambda d:d[0]*dr+d[1]*dc)
                pr,pc=cs[0][0]+dd[0],cs[0][1]+dd[1]; g=0
                while 0<=pr<H and 0<=pc<W and res[pr][pc]==bg:
                    g+=1; res[pr][pc]=v; pr+=dd[0]; pc+=dd[1]
                continue
            # multi-cell group: tail-end heuristic
            # compute degree (same-color diagonal neighbors) per cell
            deg={p:sum(1 for q in grp if (abs(p[0]-q[0])==1 and abs(p[1]-q[1])==1) and q!=p) for p in grp}
            # extreme cells: min row and max row
            ends=[cs[0],cs[-1]]
            cand=[]
            for e in ends:
                d=deg[e]
                if d>=2: continue  # not an end of a tail
                # direction: along the tail of this cell
                nb=[q for q in grp if abs(e[0]-q[0])==1 and abs(e[1]-q[1])==1]
                if not nb: continue
                prev=nb[0]
                dd=(e[0]-prev[0], e[1]-prev[1])
                pr,pc=e[0]+dd[0],e[1]+dd[1]; g=0
                while 0<=pr<H and 0<=pc<W and res[pr][pc]==bg:
                    g+=1; res[pr][pc]=v; pr+=dd[0]; pc+=dd[1]
                cand.append((g,e,dd,v))
            if cand:
                cand.sort(key=lambda t:-t[0])
                g,e,dd,val=cand[0]
                cur=(e[0]+dd[0],e[1]+dd[1])
                while 0<=cur[0]<H and 0<=cur[1]<W and res[cur[0]][cur[1]]==bg:
                    res[cur[0]][cur[1]]=val; cur=(cur[0]+dd[0],cur[1]+dd[1])
    return res

def sign(x): return 1 if x>0 else -1

for k in range(1,5):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    r=f(I)
    ok=r==O
    print(k, ok)

        print('  diffs:',diffs[:10])

def f(g):
    bg=g[0][0]; out=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    dirs=[(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]
            st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
            while st:
                x,y=st.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in dirs:
                    nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and not seen[nx][ny] and g[nx][ny]==c:
                        seen[nx][ny]=True; st.append((nx,ny))
            pts=sorted(comp)
            best=max(pts,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1]))  # last point of main diagonal
            dr=best[0]-pts[0][0]; dc=best[1]-pts[0][1]
            d=(dr//abs(dr),dc//abs(dc)) if (dr or dc) else (0,0)
            ii,jj=best[0]+d[0],best[1]+d[1]
            while 0<=ii<h and 0<=jj<w and g[ii][jj]==bg:
                out[ii][jj]=c; ii+=d[0]; jj+=d[1]
    return out
